# GLAD (generated)

OpenGL function loader, generated with glad 2.0.8 (https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad):

    pip install glad2
    glad --api gl:core=3.3,wgl=1.0 \
         --extensions WGL_ARB_create_context,WGL_ARB_create_context_profile,WGL_ARB_pixel_format,WGL_EXT_swap_control \
         --out-path third_party/glad c

Generated files are not edited by hand; regenerate to change the API or extensions.

(see the notices at the top of each file).
